name: Cortex
tagline: The central brain: MIDI routing, processing and scenes in one box.
description:
Cortex is the heart of the MusicBrain family. It routes, filters and transforms MIDI between all your gear, and switches your entire rig with a single scene change.

Built on open firmware — configure it with the free editor & simulator, or hack it yourself.

specs.label: MIDI I/O
specs.value: 4x DIN in, 4x DIN out, USB host + device
